# Requirements Checklist: Nutrition Search (AI-Powered Food Logging)

**Purpose**: Verify the spec satisfies every user-stated acceptance criterion and the constitution (Day 12, P24–P30) constraints before planning.
**Created**: 2026-09-13
**Feature**: [specs/018-ai-nutrition-search/spec.md](../../018-ai-nutrition-search/spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/sp.specify` command based on the feature description and constitution requirements.

**Verification Status (2026-09-13):** All 27 items closed during `/sp.implement` (T046). Static + build-gate evidence recorded per item. SC-007 (CHK018) and SC-008 (CHK020) additionally verified by the P27 audit (quickstart §3); the remaining live checks (quickstart §4) are queued for manual browser sign-off in T044.

## Search Input & Live AI

- [X] CHK001 User searches by natural-language food description only; no manual macro entry and no keyword database.
- [X] CHK002 Every search hits the live AI (Gemini) through the authenticated backend proxy.
- [X] CHK003 No static/hardcoded source of nutrition truth behind results.

## Result Card

- [X] CHK004 Result shows a single card with food name, "AI" badge, "Per Xg serving" label, and Calories | Protein | Carbs | Fat.
- [X] CHK005 Optional micronutrients Fiber | Sugar | Sodium shown when the AI provides them.
- [X] CHK006 AI result presented as assistant suggestion (badge), not authoritative.

## Add-to-Log Modal

- [X] CHK007 "+" on the result card opens the Add-to-Log modal.
- [X] CHK008 Modal pre-fills quantity (grams) from the AI result and allows editing.
- [X] CHK009 Live recalculation "For [X]g: [Y] kcal | P | C | F" derives strictly from the AI's real data.
- [X] CHK010 Meal dropdown offers Breakfast | Lunch | Dinner | Snack.
- [X] CHK011 Cancel closes the modal and persists nothing.

## Persistence & Real-Time Reflection

- [X] CHK012 Confirm saves the entry to the real database, owner-scoped to the authenticated user.
- [X] CHK013 Saved food appears under the correct meal section immediately (no refresh).
- [X] CHK014 Meal sections show their logged foods; no cross-meal leakage.

## Empty, Loading & Error States

- [X] CHK015 Empty meal section shows "No food logged for [Meal]" and hint "Use AI search above to find and add foods."
- [X] CHK016 Loading state shown during AI calls.
- [X] CHK017 Error/empty state on AI failure with retry; zero fabricated numbers.

## Security & Isolation

- [X] CHK018 Gemini key exists only on the backend; not exposed to the client.
- [X] CHK019 All search/save requests require authentication.
- [X] CHK020 Entries scoped to the authenticated user and isolated from other users.

## Spec Quality

- [X] CHK021 Spec contains prioritized user stories (P1/P2 ordered by journey importance) with independent tests and Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios.
- [X] CHK022 Spec lists edge cases for empty/whitespace input, AI timeout, unmappable response, invalid quantity, rapid searches, duplicate confirms.
- [X] CHK023 Functional requirements are technology-agnostic capability statements.
- [X] CHK024 Key Entities section covers owned nutrition entries, meal sections, and the authenticated owner.
- [X] CHK025 Success criteria are measurable and technology-agnostic.
- [X] CHK026 No more than 3 `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers (currently 1: cross-user access semantics beyond login scoping).
- [X] CHK027 No `[###-feature-name]`, `[DATE]`, or other unfilled template tokens remain.
